alerts: ALERT: On Sept. 4, 2026, USCIS published the Registration of Lawful Permanent Residence for Children Born to Foreign Government Employees in the United States, Interim Final Rule and a new 09/04/26 edition of the Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status. Given the injunction currently in place in Casa Inc. v. Trump, No. 8:25-cv-00201 (D. Md Sep. 2, 2026), DHS will not take actions to implement the IFR or the 09/04/26 edition of Form I-485 specifically to any member of the certified class, or otherwise conflict with the preliminary injunction, unless and until the government obtains relief from the injunction. If the government obtains timely relief from the injunction, DHS will implement the rule accordingly.

ALERT: On Sept. 18, 2026, USCIS published a revised edition of Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status (edition date: 09/18/26). The form has been revised to align with the recently announced Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility Final Rule. There is no grace period for the revised edition of Form I-485 because this revision is necessary for USCIS to apply the final rule. Please note that USCIS will: Reject the 01/20/25 and 09/04/26 edition of Form I-485 if it is postmarked or electronically submitted on or after Sept. 18, 2026; and Only accept the 09/18/26 edition of Form I-485 if it is postmarked or electronically submitted on or after Sept. 18, 2026.
forms.note: 09/18/26 新版已发布并生效，现在只接受这一版。 USCIS 于 2026 年 9 月 18 日发布该版，公告说明改版是为配合新近公布的公共负担 不可入境事由最终规则（Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility Final Rule）， 并写明因本次改版是适用该规则所必需，不设宽限期：以邮戳或电子提交日计， 9 月 18 日当天及以后提交的 01/20/25 与 09/04/26 两版一律退件，只接受 09/18/26 版。 Edition Date 面板已同步更新为 09/18/26，不再列出任何也接受的旧版， 9 月 18 日那天「公告已到期、面板仍停在 09/04/26」的矛盾已经消失。 另需留意：关于 09/04/26 版的 Casa Inc. v. Trump 禁令公告仍挂在页首 （案号 8:25-cv-00201，马里兰州联邦地区法院，2026 年 9 月 2 日）， DHS 在其中称在取得救济之前不对该案认证集体成员实施该临时最终规则和 09/04/26 版， 并称若及时取得救济即按该规则实施；这条公告与 9 月 18 日换版公告之间的关系 官网没有说明，涉及该案认证集体成员的案件由主办律师判断。 现在提交一律用 09/18/26 版，01/20/25 与 09/04/26 两版都不再接受。

alerts: ALERT: On Sept.14, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts issued an order postponing the effective date of the final rule entitled "Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors, and Representatives of Foreign Information Media," published at 91 Fed. Reg. 44976 (July 17, 2026). See Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration, et al., v. DHS, 26-cv-13799 (D. Mass.). DHS is preliminarily enjoined from taking any further action to implement the final rule, and the effective date of the final rule is postponed pending further order of the court or resolution of the proceeding on the merits. DHS strongly disagrees with the court's order and if the order is lifted, will take measures to implement the final rule. Until such time, USCIS will proceed under the previous regulatory provisions. Pursuant to the Sept. 14, 2026, order, USCIS continues to accept the 08/28/24 edition of Form I-539 and 08/21/25 edition of Form I-765 and is not accepting the 09/15/26 edition of Forms I-539 and I-765.
forms.note: 换版已被法院叫停，现在仍用 08/21/25 版。 2026 年 9 月 14 日，马萨诸塞州联邦法院下达命令，推迟了「为非移民学术学生、 交流访客以及外国媒体代表确定固定的入境期限和延长的停留期限」这条最终规则的生效日期 （91 Fed. Reg. 44976，2026 年 7 月 17 日；案件为 Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration v. DHS，案号 26-cv-13799，马萨诸塞州）。 DHS 被暂时禁止采取任何进一步行动实施该规则，直至法院下达进一步命令或案件实质问题得到解决。 原先那条「9 月 15 日起旧版一律退件、无宽限期」的公告已被这条法院公告取代，官网上已经删除。 根据这项命令，USCIS 仍接受 08/21/25 版，09/15/26 版则不再被接受。 另需留意：DHS 明确表示不认同该裁定，若禁令解除会重新推进换版，所以这个状态可能再次翻转。

forms.cn: 经济担保书

forms.raw: 08/24/26. You can find the edition date at the bottom of the page on the form and instructions.
alerts: ALERT: On Aug. 31, 2026, USCIS published a new edition of Form I-864, Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA (edition date: 08/24/26). USCIS is providing a 30-day grace period during which we will accept the 10/17/24 edition of Form I-864. Beginning Oct. 1, 2026, we will only accept the 08/24/26 edition of Form I-864. USCIS will not process any 10/17/24 edition of Form I-864 postmarked or electronically submitted on or after Oct. 1, 2026. USCIS does not reject Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, if it is filed with a previous edition of Form I-864. If an edition other than 08/24/26 is submitted on or after Oct. 1, 2026, USCIS will follow 8 CFR 103.2(b)(8) regarding the applicant's failure to submit the required initial evidence. Please note: The 08/24/26 edition of Form I-864 includes a privacy release that authorizes USCIS to request information from one or more consumer reporting agencies. If a sponsor has a credit or security freeze on their consumer or credit report file, USCIS may not be able to access the information necessary to assess the sufficiency of Form I-864. To avoid any delays, a sponsor should expeditiously respond to any requests made to release a credit or security freeze.
forms.note: **旧版 10/17/24 的宽限期到 9 月 30 日为止**，自 10/01/26 起只接受 08/24/26 版。 附了旧版 I-864 不会导致 I-485 被退件，但会按「缺少初始证据」处理。 另需提醒担保人：新版含征信授权条款，若其信用报告设有冻结，应尽早解除， 否则 USCIS 无法核实经济能力，会拖慢审理。
